summary: This dataset contains a high-resolution visual record of a single jade object (Specimen ID: EANJ_FACE_22) with images captured using a full-frame digital camera and 90 mm macro lens, including multi-angle overall views, macro images, and a scale-reference image. The dataset includes 7 image files in JPEG format, with approximate reference measurements of length (8.2 cm), width (7.9 cm), thickness (2.2 cm), and weight (236 g). The dataset is intended for non-invasive visual observation, comparative image-based analysis, and referential use in academic research.
